docs.title: Agentrum
docs.text: 多租户的企业级 AI 资产注册中心 — 发布 · 订阅 · 部署 Agent、MCP Server、Skill 与 Prompt。

docs.title: 按角色找文档
docs.text: 你是谁 从这里开始 想发布资源的开发者 快速开始 → CLI 参考 → 资源规范 写脚本 / CI / 运行时 API 参考(AK/SK 认证、错误码、分页) 项目管理员 订阅与通知 → SSO 接入 平台 / SRE 部署接入 → 运维手册

docs.title: 三个核心概念
docs.text:
1. 项目(Project):资源的隔离单元,平台管理员开通,成员分 admin / publisher / member 三种角色
  2. AK/SK:项目级机器凭据,注册、发现、调用必须携带;scopes 控制 read/publish/deploy
  3. 订阅:跨团队消费的授权 + 通知机制;internal 直接生效,restricted 需属主审批,Prompt 仅本项目私有

交互式 API 文档(OpenAPI)由服务直接提供:/docs。

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text: Interactive OpenAPI is served by the app itself: /docs (Swagger UI) and /openapi.json. This page organizes the integration essentials by scenario.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
Every /v1/* endpoint requires auth, in one of two forms:

# 1) Account JWT: exchange credentials via POST /v1/auth/login
curl -s $SERVER/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"..."}'
# Then: Authorization: Bearer <token>

# 2) Project AK/SK: HTTP Basic (recommended for CI / runtime)
curl -s -u "$ARK_AK:$ARK_SK" $SERVER/v1/resources

Quick rules:

  • AK/SK can only reach their own project's namespace, within the read / publish / deploy scopes granted at creation
  • Prompts are project-private — no cross-project principal (AK included) can read them
  • 5 consecutive failed logins trigger a 10-minute lockout; request bodies are capped at 2 MiB by default

docs.title: Core endpoints (by scenario)
docs.text: Scenario Endpoint Notes Publish / update PUT /v1/resources/{kind}/{namespace}/{name} Idempotent; 201 create, 200 update; tag conflict → 409 List GET /v1/resources?kind=&namespace=&q=&limit=&offset= q = substring search over name/description (pg_trgm) Get one GET /v1/resources/{kind}/{ns}/{name}?tag=&version= latest version by default Version history GET /v1/resources/{kind}/{ns}/{name}/versions includes change_notes Soft delete DELETE /v1/resources/{kind}/{ns}/{name} fires deletion notifications to subscribers Projects POST/GET /v1/teams, /v1/teams/{name}/members creating projects requires platform admin AK/SK POST/GET/DELETE /v1/teams/{name}/access-keys SK appears exactly once, in the create response Subscriptions POST /v1/teams/{team}/subscriptions see Subscribe & notifications Audit GET /v1/audit platform admin Health GET /health (liveness), GET /readyz (readiness incl. DB) for probes

docs.title: Response & error conventions
docs.text:
// Success (resource object)
{"kind": "MCPServer", "namespace": "payment", "name": "payment-gateway",
 "visibility": "internal", "catalog": {}, "status": {},
 "latest_version": {"version": 3, "tag": "v1.3.0", "spec": {...},
                    "change_notes": "...", "published_by": "alice"}}

// Failure (stable machine-readable code + human detail)
{"code": "conflict", "detail": "tag 'v1.2.0' already exists; tags are immutable"}
Status Meaning 400 Validation failed (spec violates the kind contract, bad params) 401 Unauthenticated / expired credentials 403 Forbidden (insufficient role, missing scope, private/restricted resource) 404 Not found 409 Conflict (immutable tag, duplicate subscription, concurrent write) 413 Body too large 429 Rate limited / account locked

Troubleshooting: every response carries an X-Request-ID header that matches request_id in structured logs (enable ARK_LOG_FORMAT=json).

docs.title: Pagination
docs.text: GET /v1/resources uses limit (default 50, max 200) + offset; responses include total. Offset pagination today; cursor pagination is planned for very large catalogs (see roadmap).

docs.title: API 参考
docs.text: 交互式 OpenAPI 文档由服务自动提供:/docs(Swagger UI)与 /openapi.json。本页是按场景组织的接入要点。

docs.title: 认证
docs.text:
所有 /v1/* 接口都需要认证,支持两种形态:

# 1) 账号 JWT:POST /v1/auth/login 换取 token
curl -s $SERVER/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"..."}'
# 后续请求:Authorization: Bearer <token>

# 2) 项目 AK/SK:HTTP Basic(推荐用于 CI / 运行时)
curl -s -u "$ARK_AK:$ARK_SK" $SERVER/v1/resources

规则速记:

  • AK/SK 只能触达所属项目的命名空间,且受 read / publish / deploy scopes 限制
  • Prompt 资源是项目私有,任何跨项目主体(含 AK)都读不到
  • 登录连续失败 5 次触发锁定(10 分钟);请求体上限默认 2 MiB

docs.title: 核心端点(按场景)
docs.text: 场景 端点 说明 发布 / 更新 PUT /v1/resources/{kind}/{namespace}/{name} 幂等;创建返回 201,更新返回 200;tag 冲突 409 查询列表 GET /v1/resources?kind=&namespace=&q=&limit=&offset= q 为名称/描述子串搜索(pg_trgm 加速) 查询单个 GET /v1/resources/{kind}/{ns}/{name}?tag=&version= 缺省返回最新版本 版本历史 GET /v1/resources/{kind}/{ns}/{name}/versions 含 change_notes 软删除 DELETE /v1/resources/{kind}/{ns}/{name} 触发订阅方删除通知 项目 POST/GET /v1/teams、/v1/teams/{name}/members 建项目需平台管理员 AK/SK POST/GET/DELETE /v1/teams/{name}/access-keys SK 仅创建响应中出现一次 订阅 POST /v1/teams/{team}/subscriptions 见《订阅与通知》 审计 GET /v1/audit 平台管理员 健康检查 GET /health(存活)、GET /readyz(就绪,含 DB) 探针用

docs.title: 响应与错误约定
docs.text:
// 成功(资源对象)
{"kind": "MCPServer", "namespace": "payment", "name": "payment-gateway",
 "visibility": "internal", "catalog": {}, "status": {},
 "latest_version": {"version": 3, "tag": "v1.3.0", "spec": {...},
                    "change_notes": "...", "published_by": "alice"}}

// 失败(稳定错误码,便于程序化处理与本地化)
{"code": "conflict", "detail": "tag 'v1.2.0' already exists; tags are immutable"}
状态码 含义 400 校验失败(spec 不符合该 kind 契约、参数非法) 401 未认证 / 凭据失效 403 无权限(角色不足、scope 缺失、私有/受限资源) 404 资源不存在 409 冲突(tag 不可变、重复订阅、并发修改) 413 请求体超限 429 登录限流 / 账号锁定

排查线索:每个响应都带 X-Request-ID 响应头,与结构化日志(需 ARK_LOG_FORMAT=json)中的 request_id 对应。

docs.title: 分页
docs.text: GET /v1/resources 使用 limit(默认 50,上限 200)+ offset,响应含 total。当前为 offset 分页,数据量 >10 万行时计划升级游标制(见路线图)。

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
ui (Next.js static, i18n zh/en)
      │ REST
┌─────▼──────────────────────────────┐
│ FastAPI (routers = transport only) │
│   ├─ auth/oidc  (JWT + SSO)        │
│   ├─ resources (apply/get/delete)  │
│   ├─ subscriptions (approval)      │
│   └─ notifications (outbox)        │
├────────────────────────────────────┤
│ services (business logic)          │
│   ├─ tenancy / visibility          │
│   ├─ deployments.reconciler ───────┼──► K8s (kubernetes-asyncio)
│   ├─ probe / maintenance loops     │
│   └─ secrets (Fernet envelope)     │
├────────────────────────────────────┤
│ SQLAlchemy models (only DB layer)  │
└─────┬──────────────────────────────┘
      ▼
  PostgreSQL (JSONB specs, trigram search, outbox, audit)

Key properties:

  • Control plane, not data plane — deployed workloads run independently; consumers should tolerate registry downtime (cache resolutions).
  • Transactional outbox — notifications commit atomically with the state that caused them; a background dispatcher delivers with retries.
  • Level-triggered reconciliation — Deployment rows declare desired state; the controller converges it, writing status conditions back.

docs.title: CLI Reference
docs.text: The agentrum CLI is the main entry point for developers and CI. Install with pip install agentrum (or uv run agentrum inside a source checkout).

docs.title: Two login modes
docs.text:
Mode Audience Command Credential Account login Humans (console-equivalent rights) agentrum login --server URL --username U (password prompted) JWT, 8h validity AK/SK login CI / scripts / runtime agentrum login --server URL --ak ARK-ak-xxx --sk ARK-sk-xxx HTTP Basic, constrained by project scopes

Credentials live in ~/.agentrum/credentials.json (chmod 0600). For CI prefer environment variables AGENTRUM_SERVER / AGENTRUM_TOKEN or AGENTRUM_AK / AGENTRUM_SK — nothing touches disk.

!!! note "Scope differences" AK/SK are project-scoped: they can only touch that project's namespace and only within the read / publish / deploy scopes chosen at creation. Management operations (creating projects, member management) require account login.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
agentrum login        # login (account or AK/SK)
agentrum apply FILE   # publish YAML manifests (--- separated, kubectl style)
agentrum get KIND     # list; agentrum get KIND NAME -n NS for one (JSON output)
agentrum delete KIND ns/name   # soft delete (re-applying restores)
agentrum init KIND NAME        # scaffold: agent | mcp-server | skill | prompt
agentrum export -o bundle.yaml # export resources (all versions) for promotion
agentrum configure --client cursor   # write the registry into an IDE MCP config
agentrum version      # server version

docs.title: Typical flow
docs.text:
agentrum init mcp-server payment-gateway && cd payment-gateway
# edit agentrum.yaml (see the Resource spec page), then:
agentrum apply agentrum.yaml
agentrum get MCPServer -n payment

# Promotion: point at the production registry and replay
agentrum export -o bundle.yaml -n payment
ARK_SERVER=https://registry.prod.internal ARK_AK=... ARK_SK=... agentrum apply bundle.yaml

!!! warning "Secrets are never exported" agentrum export strips Secret values (keys only) — re-enter them in the target environment.

docs.title: CLI 参考
docs.text: agentrum CLI 是开发者与 CI 的主要入口。安装:pip install agentrum(或源码内 uv sync 后 uv run agentrum)。

docs.title: 两种登录方式
docs.text:
方式 适用 命令 凭据形态 账号登录 人(控制台同等权限) agentrum login --server URL --username U(密码交互输入) JWT,8 小时有效 AK/SK 登录 CI / 脚本 / 运行时 agentrum login --server URL --ak ARK-ak-xxx --sk ARK-sk-xxx HTTP Basic,受项目 scopes 约束

凭据保存在 ~/.agentrum/credentials.json(权限 0600);CI 中推荐直接用环境变量 AGENTRUM_SERVER / AGENTRUM_TOKEN 或 AGENTRUM_AK / AGENTRUM_SK,无需落盘。

!!! note "权限差异" AK/SK 是项目级凭据:只能读写该项目命名空间、且受创建时勾选的 read / publish / deploy scopes 限制;管理操作(建项目、成员管理)必须用账号登录。

docs.title: 命令一览
docs.text:
agentrum login        # 登录(账号或 AK/SK)
agentrum apply FILE   # 发布 YAML 清单(-- 分隔多文档,kubectl 风格)
agentrum get KIND     # 列表;agentrum get KIND NAME -n NS 查看单个(输出 JSON)
agentrum delete KIND ns/name   # 软删除(重新 apply 同名资源即恢复)
agentrum init KIND NAME        # 脚手架:agent | mcp-server | skill | prompt
agentrum export -o bundle.yaml # 导出资源(含全部版本)用于跨环境提升
agentrum configure --client cursor   # 一键把注册中心写进 IDE 的 MCP 配置
agentrum version      # 服务端版本

docs.title: 典型流程
docs.text:
# 1. 脚手架并发布一个 MCP Server
agentrum init mcp-server payment-gateway && cd payment-gateway
#    编辑 agentrum.yaml(见《资源规范》),然后:
agentrum apply agentrum.yaml

# 2. 查看发布结果
agentrum get MCPServer -n payment

# 3. 跨环境提升:指向生产注册中心重放同一份内容
agentrum export -o bundle.yaml -n payment
ARK_SERVER=https://registry.prod.internal ARK_AK=... ARK_SK=... agentrum apply bundle.yaml

!!! warning "导出不包含 Secret 值" agentrum export 对 Secret 资源只导出键名,值强制剥离——需在目标环境重新录入。

docs.title: Deploy to Kubernetes
docs.text: The Agentrum deployment controller treats Deployment resources as desired state and reconciles them level-triggered into the target cluster using a native Kubernetes adapter (no kagent dependency).

docs.title: Publish a deployment
docs.text:
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: fraud-detection-prod, namespace: payment}
spec:
  target_kind: Agent
  target_namespace: payment
  target_name: fraud-detection
  tag: v1.0.0            # optional: pin a tag; default follows latest
  cluster_namespace: agents
  replicas: 2
  port: 8000
  image_pull_policy: IfNotPresent

The controller resolves the target's image → enforces ARK_IMAGE_ALLOWLIST → resolves env.secretRef credentials → creates/updates a Deployment + Service in the cluster → writes the outcome back into status.conditions.

docs.title: Image allowlist (required in production)
docs.text:
Publish rights ≈ code-execution rights, so what may run in the cluster must be controlled:

ARK_IMAGE_ALLOWLIST=registry.internal/,ghcr.io/acme/

Images outside the allowlist never reach the cluster; the Deployment shows an ImageNotAllowed condition instead.

docs.title: Observing status
docs.text:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  $SERVER/v1/resources/Deployment/payment/fraud-detection-prod | jq .status

Conditions carry reason (Reconciled / TargetMissing / NoImage / ImageNotAllowed / EnvResolutionFailed / AdapterError). Soft-deleting the Deployment resource makes the controller clean up the workload.

docs.title: Cluster-side setup
docs.text:
• In-cluster config is used automatically when the controller runs inside K8s; local dev falls back to kubeconfig
  • RBAC is namespace-scoped least-privilege (charts/agentrum/templates/serviceaccount.yaml): only Deployment/Service CRUD, only in the controller's namespace
  • Reconcile interval: ARK_DEPLOY_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 10s)

!!! note "Credentials in deployments" Secrets referenced via env.secret_ref are resolved by Agentrum at reconcile time and injected as container env vars; the values stay envelope-encrypted in the database and are never returned by the API.

docs.title: 部署接入(Kubernetes)
docs.text: Agentrum 的部署控制器把 Deployment 资源当作期望状态,级别触发地调和到目标集群——使用原生 Kubernetes 适配器(不依赖 kagent)。

docs.title: 发布一个部署
docs.text:
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: fraud-detection-prod, namespace: payment}
spec:
  target_kind: Agent
  target_namespace: payment
  target_name: fraud-detection
  tag: v1.0.0            # 可选:锁定版本 tag;缺省跟随最新
  cluster_namespace: agents
  replicas: 2
  port: 8000
  image_pull_policy: IfNotPresent

控制器会:解析目标资源的镜像 → 校验 ARK_IMAGE_ALLOWLIST → 解析 env.secretRef 凭据 → 在集群内创建/更新 Deployment + Service → 把结果写回资源的 status.conditions。

docs.title: 镜像白名单(生产必设)
docs.text:
发布权 ≈ 代码执行权,因此集群里能跑什么镜像必须受控:

ARK_IMAGE_ALLOWLIST=registry.internal/,ghcr.io/acme/

不在白名单内的镜像不会下发到集群,Deployment 条目显示 ImageNotAllowed 条件。

docs.title: 观察状态
docs.text:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  $SERVER/v1/resources/Deployment/payment/fraud-detection-prod | jq .status

条件类型:Ready(True/False)+ reason(Reconciled / TargetMissing / NoImage / ImageNotAllowed / EnvResolutionFailed / AdapterError)。软删除 Deployment 资源会触发控制器清理集群内工作负载。

docs.title: 集群侧配置
docs.text:
• 控制器在集群内运行时自动使用 in-cluster 配置;本地开发用 kubeconfig
  • ServiceAccount RBAC 按命名空间最小授权(见 charts/agentrum/templates/serviceaccount.yaml):仅 Deployment/Service 的增删改查,仅限控制器所在命名空间
  • 控制器调和周期:ARK_DEPLOY_INTERVAL_SECONDS(默认 10s)

!!! note "部署目标里的凭据" env.secret_ref 引用的 Secret 资源在调和时由 Agentrum 解出明文注入容器环境变量;Secret 值本身在数据库中信封加密,且永远不会通过 API 返回。

docs.title: IDE integration (MCP)
docs.text: The Agentrum registry is itself an MCP server — Cursor, Claude Code, Cline and other MCP clients can ask the registry directly: which MCP servers / agents are available, what are their endpoints, what is the latest version. Read-only tool surface; permissions match the console exactly (JWT or project AK/SK).

docs.title: Endpoint & auth
docs.text:
Streamable HTTP:  http://<registry-host>:12122/mcp
Auth:             Authorization: Bearer <JWT>   or   Authorization: Basic <AK>:<SK> (base64)

Give your IDE a read-only (read scope) project AK/SK: console → project → Settings → AK/SK.

docs.title: Cursor / Claude Code config
docs.text:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agentrum": {
      "url": "http://localhost:12122/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Basic <base64(AK:SK)>"
      }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Exposed tools
docs.text:
Tool Purpose registry_overview visible resource counts per kind + server version list_resources browse the catalog by kind/namespace/keyword (visibility-filtered) get_resource one resource: latest (or pinned) spec, endpoint, change notes, catalog metadata list_prompts prompt templates visible to you (prompts are project-private), with declared variables get_prompt fetch a template; or render server-side with variables_json (required/unknown variables validated)

Typical flow: ask the IDE "which payment-related MCP servers are in the registry?" — the client calls list_resources(search=payment), then get_resource for the endpoint and version, ready to wire into config.

!!! note "Visibility is the permission" Tool output matches what the calling principal sees in the console: an AK/SK sees its own project plus subscriptions, internal resources are org-wide, Prompts stay project-private.

docs.title: IDE 接入(MCP)
docs.text: Agentrum 注册中心自身就是一个 MCP Server——Cursor、Claude Code、Cline 等 MCP 客户端可以直接"问"注册中心:有哪些可用的 MCP 服务/Agent,端点是什么,最新版本到哪了。只读工具面,权限与控制台完全一致(JWT 或项目 AK/SK)。

docs.title: 端点与认证
docs.text:
Streamable HTTP:  http://<registry-host>:12122/mcp
认证:             Authorization: Bearer <JWT>   或   Authorization: Basic <AK>:<SK>(base64)

建议给 IDE 配一把只读(read scope)的项目 AK/SK:控制台 → 项目 → 设置 → AK/SK 凭据。

docs.title: Cursor / Claude Code 配置
docs.text:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "agentrum": {
      "url": "http://localhost:12122/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Basic <base64(AK:SK)>"
      }
    }
  }
}

docs.title: 暴露的工具
docs.text:
工具 说明 registry_overview 各 kind 可见资源数量 + 服务版本 list_resources 按类型/命名空间/关键字列目录(可见性过滤后) get_resource 取单个资源详情:最新(或指定 tag)的 spec、端点、change_notes、目录元数据 list_prompts 列出可见的 Prompt 模板(Prompt 项目私有),含已声明变量 get_prompt 取模板;或带 variables_json 服务端渲染(必填/未声明强校验)

典型用法:在 IDE 里问"注册中心里有哪些支付相关的 MCP 服务?"——客户端调用 list_resources(search=支付),再 get_resource 拿到端点与版本,直接接入配置。

!!! note "可见性即权限" 工具返回内容与调用主体在控制台里能看到的一致:AK/SK 只见所属项目与已订阅内容,internal 资源全公司可见,Prompt 项目私有不可见。

docs.title: Agentrum
docs.text: A multi-tenant registry for AI assets — publish, subscribe to and run agents, MCP servers, skills and prompts.

docs.title: Find docs by role
docs.text: You are… Start here A developer publishing assets Quick start → CLI reference → Resource spec Writing scripts / CI / runtime API reference (AK/SK auth, errors, pagination) A project admin Subscribe & notifications → SSO setup Platform / SRE Deploy to K8s → Operations handbook

docs.title: Three core concepts
docs.text:
1. Project: the isolation unit, provisioned by platform admins; members hold admin / publisher / member roles
  2. AK/SK: project-scoped machine credentials — registration, discovery and consumption all carry them; scopes gate read/publish/deploy
  3. Subscription: cross-team consumption with authorization + notifications; internal is instant, restricted needs owner approval, Prompts stay project-private

Interactive OpenAPI docs are served by the app at /docs.

docs.title: Environment variable reference
docs.text: Variable Default Purpose ARK_DATABASE_URL postgresql+asyncpg://agentrum:agentrum@localhost:5433/agentrum PostgreSQL DSN (external HA instance in prod) ARK_SECRET_KEY dev-insecure-change-me JWT signing key — must change ARK_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY derived from SECRET_KEY (warns) Secret envelope key (Fernet, 32-byte urlsafe b64) ARK_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES 480 Session validity ARK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD admin / admin123 First-boot admin — must change ARK_ALLOWED_ORIGINS * CORS allowlist (comma-separated) ARK_LOG_FORMAT console json for log shippers ARK_MAX_BODY_BYTES 2097152 Request body cap ARK_IMAGE_ALLOWLIST empty (dev only) Deployment image prefixes, comma-separated ARK_FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL/SECRET — Feishu bot notifications ARK_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL/SECRET — Generic webhook (X-Agentrum-Signature header) ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_ISSUER/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET — Generic OIDC ARK_RATELIMIT_BACKEND memory redis shares login rate limits/lockouts across replicas (needs agentrum[redis]; fails open with a warning if Redis is down) ARK_RATELIMIT_REDIS_URL redis://localhost:6379/0 Rate-limit backend address ARK_EGRESS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ADDRESSES true Whether server-initiated outbound requests (git fetch, health probes, content delivery) may reach private ranges (internal git servers usually need this) ARK_EGRESS_ALLOW_LOOPBACK false Dev escape hatch: allow loopback/link-local (includes cloud metadata — refused by default) ARK_EGRESS_ALLOW_FILE_SOURCES false Dev/test only: allow file:// git sources ARK_SKILL_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES 52428800 Size cap for skill content tarballs ARK_RESOURCE_RETENTION_DAYS 30 days a soft-deleted resource stays in the recycle bin before the retention prune removes it for good (versions and secret payloads cascade) ARK_FEISHU_APP_ID/APP_SECRET — Feishu SSO ARK_OIDC_REDIRECT_BASE / ARK_UI_ORIGIN — Callback base / UI redirect origin ARK_PROBE_INTERVAL_SECONDS 60 MCPServer endpoint probe interval ARK_DEPLOY_INTERVAL_SECONDS 10 Deploy reconcile interval ARK_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS 180 Audit retention ARK_NOTIFICATION_RETENTION_DAYS 30 Delivered-notification retention ARK_OTEL_ENABLED / ARK_OTELENDPOINT false OTLP tracing (off by default)

docs.title: Kubernetes deployment
docs.text:
helm upgrade --install agentrum charts/agentrum \
  --set database.url="postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@db:5432/agentrum" \
  --set auth.secretKey="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" \
  --set auth.bootstrapAdminPassword="$(openssl rand -hex 16)" \
  --set secrets.encryptionKey="$(openssl rand -base64 32)" \
  --set deploy.imageAllowlist="registry.internal/" \
  --set ingress.enabled=true --set ingress.host=registry.internal

Notes: two replicas by default; migrations run in an initContainer (app pods never run alembic — no multi-replica races); /readyz includes a DB check; controller RBAC is namespace-scoped.

docs.title: Backup & restore
docs.text:
kubectl exec deploy/postgres -- pg_dump -U agentrum agentrum | gzip > backup-$(date +%F).sql.gz
gunzip -c backup-2026-10-24.sql.gz | psql -U agentrum agentrum

Secret values are envelope-encrypted — back up ARK_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY together with the dump; losing the key means losing Secrets.

docs.title: Observability
docs.text:
• /metrics: Prometheus counters/histograms (HTTP volume/latency/status)
  • ARK_LOG_FORMAT=json: structured logs with request_id (matches the X-Request-ID response header)
  • ARK_OTEL_ENABLED=true + ARK_OTEL_ENDPOINT: OTLP tracing
  • Probes: /health (process), /readyz (DB readiness)

docs.title: Consumer fault-tolerance contract (important)
docs.text: The registry is a control plane, not a data plane: deployed agents/MCP servers run independently and never route traffic through it. Consumers should cache resolutions and retry around short registry outages — do not make runtime startup hard-depend on the registry, or a blip becomes a company-wide release freeze.

docs.title: Kubernetes 部署
docs.text:
helm upgrade --install agentrum charts/agentrum \
  --set database.url="postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@db:5432/agentrum" \
  --set auth.secretKey="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" \
  --set auth.bootstrapAdminPassword="$(openssl rand -hex 16)" \
  --set secrets.encryptionKey="$(openssl rand -base64 32)" \
  --set deploy.imageAllowlist="registry.internal/" \
  --set ingress.enabled=true --set ingress.host=registry.internal

docs.text:
# 每日逻辑备份(配合 crontab / K8s CronJob)
kubectl exec deploy/postgres -- pg_dump -U agentrum agentrum | gzip > backup-$(date +%F).sql.gz
# 恢复

docs.title: 可观测性
docs.text:
• /metrics:Prometheus 指标(HTTP 请求量/时延/状态码)
  • ARK_LOG_FORMAT=json:结构化日志,含 request_id(与响应头 X-Request-ID 对应)
  • ARK_OTEL_ENABLED=true + ARK_OTEL_ENDPOINT:OTLP 追踪
  • 探活:/health(进程)、/readyz(DB 就绪)

docs.title: 消费端容错约定(重要)
docs.text: 注册中心是控制面而非数据面:已部署的 Agent/MCP Server 独立运行,不经过注册中心。消费端应缓存解析结果并对注册中心短时不可用做重试——不要让运行时强依赖注册中心,否则它的一次抖动会放大成全公司新发布停摆。

docs.title: Permission model
docs.text: Agentrum permissions have four orthogonal dimensions: platform role × project role × resource visibility × AK/SK scopes. Every mutation is audited.

docs.title: Platform role
docs.text: Capability Platform admin Regular user Create projects ✅ ❌ Designate project owner ✅ (at creation) ❌ User management (create/disable/reset password/promote) ✅ ❌ Audit query, notification pipeline observability ✅ ❌

docs.title: Project roles (owner / admin / publisher / developer / member)
docs.text:
Operation Owner/Admin Publisher Developer Member Manage members ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ Create/revoke project AK/SK ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ Transfer ownership Owner only ❌ ❌ ❌ Publish/update resources (PUT) ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ Manage Deployments ✅ ✅ ❌ ❌ Edit metadata (PATCH, no version) ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ Soft-delete resources ✅ ✅ ❌ ❌ Approve subscription requests ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ Revoke grants ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ Create subscriptions ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅

Developer vs publisher boundary: publish yes, delete no, deployments no — misoperation protection and deployment-rights separation.

docs.title: Resource visibility (read)
docs.text: visibility Who can read Cross-project subscription internal All authenticated users Instant restricted Owning project + granted projects Owner admin approval private (Prompt only) Owning project members only Not allowed

docs.title: AK/SK scopes (machine credentials)
docs.text:
scope Allowed read Catalog discovery, subscription management publish Publish/update/delete Agent, MCPServer, Skill, Prompt, Secret deploy Publish/update/delete Deployment resources (triggers cluster reconciliation)

Three locks always apply: project boundary, scope allowlist, resource visibility. Deployment resources require the dedicated deploy scope — publish rights do not include the right to run code in the cluster.

docs.title: Ownership
docs.text: Each project has exactly one owner (designated at creation, transferable by the owner or a platform admin). The new owner becomes an admin member; the previous owner is demoted to member. Stored explicitly as teams.owner_user_id.

docs.title: Audit
docs.text: All of the above mutations land in audit_log with actor, time, source IP and context; 180-day retention by default.

docs.title: 权限模型
docs.text: Agentrum 的权限由四个正交维度组成:平台角色 × 项目角色 × 资源可见性 × AK/SK scopes。所有变更写入审计日志。

docs.title: 平台角色
docs.text: 能力 平台管理员 普通用户 创建项目 ✅ ❌ 指定项目 Owner ✅(建项目时) ❌ 用户管理(建号/禁用/重置密码/授平台管理员) ✅ ❌ 审计流水查询 ✅ ❌ 通知管道观测 ✅ ❌ 全局资源可见 ✅ 按可见性与成员关系

docs.title: 项目角色(Owner / 管理员 / 发布者 / 开发者 / 成员)
docs.text:
项目 Owner 是项目的责任管理员(创建时指定,可转让);管理员角色可以有多人。

操作 Owner/管理员 发布者 开发者 成员 管理成员(增删改角色) ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ 创建/吊销项目 AK/SK ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ 转让项目所有权 Owner ✅(其他人 ❌) ❌ ❌ ❌ 发布/更新资源(PUT) ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ 管理 Deployment(部署) ✅ ✅ ❌ ❌ 编辑元数据(PATCH,不产生版本) ✅ ✅ ✅ ❌ 软删除资源 ✅ ✅ ❌ ❌ 审批订阅申请(目标为本项目) ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ 收回授权(目标为本项目) ✅ ❌ ❌ ❌ 新建订阅(作为订阅方) ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ 浏览目录(可见性过滤后) ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅

开发者与发布者的边界:能发布、不能删除、不能碰部署——防误删与部署权分离。

docs.title: 资源可见性(读取)
docs.text: visibility 谁能读 跨项目订阅 internal 全部登录用户 直接生效 restricted 属主项目 + 已授权项目 属主项目管理员审批 private(仅 Prompt) 仅属主项目成员 不允许

docs.title: AK/SK scopes(机器凭据)
docs.text:
AK/SK 绑定单个项目,与其项目角色叠加使用;scope 决定这把钥匙能做什么:

scope 允许的操作 read 目录发现(list/get)、订阅管理 publish 发布/更新/删除 Agent、MCPServer、Skill、Prompt、Secret deploy 发布/更新/删除 Deployment 资源(触发集群调和)

约束:三把锁同时生效——项目边界(只能动所属项目命名空间)、scope 白名单、资源可见性。Deployment 资源要求独立的 deploy scope:发布权(publish)不等于让代码跑进集群的权力(deploy)。

docs.title: 所有权
docs.text:
• 每个项目有且只有一个 Owner(创建时指定,可转让)
  • 转让仅限当前 Owner 或平台管理员;新 Owner 自动成为项目管理员,原 Owner 降为成员
  • Owner 概念是显式字段(teams.owner_user_id),不随管理员人数变化而模糊

docs.title: 审计
docs.text: 以上所有变更(发布、删除、订阅、审批、授权、成员、AK/SK、密码变更)全部落 audit_log,含操作者、时间、来源 IP 与上下文;保留期默认 180 天。

docs.title: Resource spec (agentrum.yaml)
docs.text:
All resources share one envelope: kind + metadata + spec, submitted via agentrum apply or PUT /v1/resources/.... Extra fields in spec are allowed (forward compatibility), but each kind enforces a minimal contract; every published version is stamped with a spec_version field so shape evolution is detectable.

Editor support: add $schema: http://<server>/v1/schema/manifest.json to your agentrum.yaml (public endpoint, no credentials needed) and yaml-language-server will validate/complete the manifest. Templates from agentrum init carry the key already.

kind: MCPServer
$schema: http://localhost:12122/v1/schema/manifest.json
metadata:
  name: payment-gateway        # lowercase/digits/-; unique per (kind, namespace, name)
  namespace: payment           # owning project namespace
  labels: {team: payment}
spec:                          # per-kind payload, see table
  transport: streamable-http
  endpoint: http://pg.payment:3000/mcp
tag: v1.2.0                    # immutable: re-publishing the same tag → 409
change_notes: what changed     # sent to subscribers
description: Payment gateway MCP
visibility: internal           # internal | restricted (prompts forced private)
catalog:                       # mutable catalog metadata (no new version)
  title: Payment Gateway
  long_description: "Markdown long description…"
  keywords: [payment, mcp]
  authors: [alice]
  license: Apache-2.0
  links: {docs: "https://...", source: "https://..."}

docs.title: Per-kind spec contracts
Env vars & Secret references
docs.text:
kind: Agent
metadata: {name: fraud-detection, namespace: payment}
spec:
  image: registry.internal/fraud:1.0
  env:
    - {name: LOG_LEVEL, value: info}
    - name: API_KEY
      value_from:
        secret_ref: {name: api-keys, key: API_KEY}   # same-project Secret

docs.title: Visibility model
docs.text:
visibility Who can read Cross-project subscription internal All authenticated users Active immediately restricted Owning project + subscribed projects Owner-team admin approval private (Prompt only) Owning project members only Not allowed

Publishing requires the publisher/admin role in the owning namespace, or a project AK/SK with the publish scope. Versions are monotonic, tags immutable; soft-deleted resources are restored by re-applying.

docs.title: Git-backed skills
docs.text:
Skill content is best kept in git; the registry stores a pointer plus the pinned commit SHA:

kind: Skill
metadata: {name: gateway-skill, namespace: payment}
spec:
  source:
    git:
      url: https://git.internal/pay/skills.git
      ref: main                      # branch / tag / full commit SHA
      subdirectory: skills/gateway   # optional
      credentials_ref: git-creds     # optional: Secret with username/password or token
  entrypoint: SKILL.md               # optional entry file inside the repo

At publish time the server resolves ref to a commit SHA and locks it into the immutable version — even when ref names a branch, the version records where upstream stood at publish time. Unresolvable sources (unreachable repo, missing ref, bad credentials) block the publish. Background drift detection (ARK_SKILL_DRIFT_INTERVAL_SECONDS, default 300s, 0 disables) marks an UpstreamDrift condition when upstream moves — it never rewrites versions; re-publish to catch up. SSH is not supported yet; HTTPS + token credentials cover internal GitLab/GitHub.

At publish time the entrypoint file (default SKILL.md) is also snapshotted into the version spec (entrypoint_snapshot: path, content, parsed frontmatter), so published versions stay self-contained even if the upstream repo disappears. When SKILL.md carries standard frontmatter: name must match the resource name and description is required (Anthropic skill format) — mismatches are rejected at publish.

docs.title: MCP Server connection snippets
docs.text:
From catalog entry to working client config in one call:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://<server>/v1/resources/MCPServer/payment/payment-gateway/connect

Returns the transport, the stdio launch (command/args/env) or remote url/headers, plus three ready-to-paste client configs: clients.claude_code (an executable claude mcp add ... line), clients.cursor and clients.generic (standard mcpServers JSON). Env/headers backed by registry Secrets are never included in the snippet — they surface in notes instead, telling consumers to configure them client-side. The MCP channel (get_resource tool) carries the same connect block for in-IDE consumption.

docs.title: Deprecation
docs.text:
Soft-delete is not the only way to retire a resource: deprecate it first — the resource stays visible and consumable, subscribers receive a resource.deprecated notification, and the catalog/MCP listing carry the deprecation flag:

curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"deprecated": true, "deprecation_reason": "superseded", "successor": "payment/payment-gateway-v2"}' \
  https://<server>/v1/resources/Agent/payment/payment-gateway

successor optionally points at the replacement; deprecated: false clears the marker. Deprecation notices go to all active subscribers regardless of their events preferences — it is an impact warning about content they already consume. The console shows a deprecation banner on the detail page.

docs.title: 资源规范(agentrum.yaml)
docs.text:
所有资源共用一个信封:kind + metadata + spec,通过 agentrum apply 或 PUT /v1/resources/... 提交。spec 允许多余字段(向前兼容),但必须满足各 kind 的最小契约;每次发布会在 spec 里落一个 spec_version 戳,形状演进时用它区分新旧版本。

编辑器补全:把 $schema: http://<server>/v1/schema/manifest.json 写进 agentrum.yaml(公开端点,无需凭据),yaml-language-server 即可校验/自动补全;agentrum init 生成的模板已带此键。

kind: MCPServer
$schema: http://localhost:12122/v1/schema/manifest.json
metadata:
  name: payment-gateway        # 小写字母/数字/-,全局唯一(kind+namespace+name)
  namespace: payment           # 所属项目命名空间
  labels: {team: payment}
spec:                          # 各 kind 的负载,见下表
  transport: streamable-http
  endpoint: http://pg.payment:3000/mcp
tag: v1.2.0                    # 不可变:重复发布同名 tag 返回 409
change_notes: 本次变更说明      # 随订阅通知发送
description: 支付网关 MCP
visibility: internal           # internal | restricted(prompt 强制 private)
catalog:                       # 目录元数据(可变,不产生新版本)
  title: 支付网关
  long_description: "支持 Markdown 的详细介绍…"
  keywords: [payment, mcp]
  authors: [alice]
  license: Apache-2.0
  links: {docs: "https://...", source: "https://..."}

docs.title: 各 kind 的 spec 契约
docs.text: kind 必填 常用可选 说明 Agent image framework、protocol(mcp/a2a/openapi/http/custom)、agent_card_url(A2A 卡片,protocol=a2a 时必填)、capabilities[]、env[] env 项:{name, value} 或 {name, value_from: {secret_ref: {name, key}}};集群放置(namespace/replicas)归 Deployment 管 MCPServer transport +(endpoint 或 command) args[](仅 stdio,如 npx -y @mcp/xxx 的参数)、headers[](远程鉴权头,同 env 项格式,值可引用 Secret)、env[] transport ∈ streamable-http / sse / stdio;http 类必须给 endpoint,stdio 必须给 command 且不允许 args Skill source.git.url 或 instructions(二选一) entrypoint、source.git.ref/subdirectory/credentials_ref git 来源见下节 Prompt template variables[]({name, required, description}) 仅本项目可见;模板里的 {{占位符}} 与 variables 必须一一对应,多声明/少声明都拒绝发布 Secret data(键值对象) — 值信封加密,永不回显;强制 restricted Deployment target_kind/target_namespace/target_name tag(锁定版本)、cluster_namespace、replicas、port、image_pull_policy 见《部署接入》

docs.title: 可见性模型
docs.text:
visibility 谁能读 跨项目订阅 internal 全部登录用户 直接生效 restricted 属主项目 + 已订阅项目 需属主项目 admin 审批 private(仅 Prompt) 仅属主项目成员 不允许

发布需要属主命名空间的 publisher/admin 角色,或具备 publish scope 的项目 AK/SK。版本号单调递增,tag 不可变;软删除后重新发布即恢复。

docs.title: Skill 的 git 来源
docs.text:
技能正文推荐放在 git,注册中心存“指针 + 锁定的 commit SHA”:

kind: Skill
metadata: {name: gateway-skill, namespace: payment}
spec:
  source:
    git:
      url: https://git.internal/pay/skills.git
      ref: main                      # 分支 / tag / 完整 commit SHA
      subdirectory: skills/gateway   # 可选:仓库内子目录
      credentials_ref: git-creds     # 可选:私有仓库凭据(Secret,含 username/password 或 token)
  entrypoint: SKILL.md               # 可选:仓库内入口文件

发布时服务端把 ref 解析为 commit SHA 并锁定进不可变版本——即使 ref 写的是分支,版本记录的也是发布那一刻的位置;解析失败(仓库不可达、ref 不存在、凭据无效)会直接阻断发布。后台漂移检测(ARK_SKILL_DRIFT_INTERVAL_SECONDS,默认 300s,0 关闭)发现上游移动时在资源状态标记 UpstreamDrift,不会自动改版本——重新发布即追平。SSH 协议暂不支持,HTTPS + 令牌凭据即可覆盖内部 GitLab/GitHub。

发布时还会把入口文件(默认 SKILL.md)内容快照进版本 spec(entrypoint_snapshot:路径、正文、解析出的 frontmatter),上游仓库消失后已发布版本依然自包含。若 SKILL.md 带标准 frontmatter:name 必须与资源名一致、description 必填(Anthropic skill 格式),不一致直接拒绝发布。

docs.title: MCP Server 连接片段
docs.text:
目录条目 → 可用配置,一步完成:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://<server>/v1/resources/MCPServer/payment/payment-gateway/connect

返回 transport、stdio 启动方式(command/args/env)或远程 url/headers,以及三种即贴即用的客户端配置:clients.claude_code(可直接执行的 claude mcp add ...)、clients.cursor、clients.generic(标准 mcpServers JSON)。引用了 Secret 的 env/header 不会出现在片段里,而是进入 notes 提示用户在客户端侧自行配置——注册中心的密钥永远不出服务端。MCP 通道(get_resource 工具)的返回里同样带 connect 块,IDE 内直接可取。

docs.title: 弃用(Deprecation)
docs.text:
资源下线不只有软删除一条路:先弃用——资源保持可见可读,订阅方收到 resource.deprecated 通知,目录与 MCP 列表带弃用标记:

curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"deprecated": true, "deprecation_reason": "superseded", "successor": "payment/payment-gateway-v2"}' \
  https://<server>/v1/resources/Agent/payment/payment-gateway

successor 指向替代资源(可选),deprecated: false 可撤销弃用。弃用通知发送给全部 active 订阅方(不受订阅 events 偏好限制——这是针对既有消费方的 impact warning)。控制台详情页会显示弃用横幅。

docs.title: Roadmap
docs.text:
The living roadmap with decision records lives in the repository:

  • docs/ROADMAP.md — phases, status and known trade-offs
  • docs/RESEARCH-resource-model.md — resource model completeness study vs upstream

Phases:

  1. Phase A — pilot-ready: auth hardening, user governance, Feishu notifications, CLI, CI ✅
  2. Phase B — cluster production: catalog metadata, Secrets, OIDC SSO, K8s deployment controller, Helm chart, bilingual UI, probes, search, observability ✅
  3. Phase C — open source: bilingual docs (this site), release pipeline (ghcr + cosign), multi-env promotion (agentrum export), scaffolding (agentrum init) ✅
  4. Phase D — v0.1.0 complete & secure (released as v0.1.0; pilot feedback still pending):
  5. W1 security: JWT dies on user disable, pluggable Redis rate limiting, egress guard for server-initiated requests (scheme allowlist, loopback/link-local blocked)
  6. W2 consumption closure: Skill content delivery API, Agent endpoint delivery (spec field + reconciler URL writeback + openapi_url), Python consumer SDK (agentrum.resolve()), Prompt via MCP prompts capability, agentrum configure
  7. W3 verification: kind e2e for the deploy controller, OIDC code flow against Dex in CI
  8. W4 features: subscription pin @tag, recycle bin, audit UI, UI polish
  9. W5 docs: per-kind consumer guides, uvx as the first-class CLI install

docs.title: Python SDK (consumers)
docs.text: The standard way for applications to consume registry assets at runtime: agentrum.sdk. Discovery, content fetching and template rendering through one entry point; a local cache keeps your application running when the registry is down — that is the control-plane promise.

docs.title: Install & credentials
docs.text:
pip install agentrum          # or no install at all: uvx agentrum … (CLI)

Credential resolution order: explicit arguments → AGENTRUM_AK/AGENTRUM_SK (or AGENTRUM_TOKEN) env vars → the local credentials written by agentrum login. Give applications a project AK/SK with the read scope (console → settings → AK/SK).

docs.title: resolve: one entry point for all kinds
docs.text:
import agentrum.sdk as agentrum

registry = agentrum.Registry("https://registry.internal", ak=..., sk=...)

# MCP server: endpoint + connection headers, then any MCP client
server = registry.resolve("MCPServer/payment/payment-gateway")
#   server.endpoint, server.transport, server.headers (literal values only;
#   secretRef-backed headers never leave the registry — arrange those with
#   the owning team out-of-band)

# Agent: externally hosted ones carry spec.endpoint; controller-deployed
# ones expose service_url in the Ready condition (status.conditions[0])

# Skill: locked SHA + content
skill = registry.resolve("Skill/team/pay-skill")   # skill.sha
registry.fetch_skill("Skill/team/pay-skill", dest="./skills")

# Prompt: template + declared variables, rendered locally (missing
# required / unknown variables are errors)
prompt = registry.resolve("Prompt/team/review-style")
text = prompt.render(language="python")

docs.title: Caching & outage fallback
docs.text: resolve() caches results on disk with a TTL (default 300s; ~/.agentrum/cache, override with AGENTRUM_CACHE_DIR or cache_dir). When the registry is unreachable you get the stale cached copy (resolved.stale == True); 4xx responses (bad credentials, no such resource) raise instead — those are real problems that stale data should not hide.

docs.title: Skill content delivery
docs.text:
registry.fetch_skill("Skill/team/pay-skill", dest="./skills")

The registry fetches at the locked SHA with its own stored credentials and streams a tarball — subscribers of private repositories get the bytes while the credentials never leave the registry. Extraction uses tarfile's data filter; member paths escaping the destination are refused.

Equivalent REST call: GET /v1/resources/Skill/{ns}/{name}/content?tag=… (response header X-Agentrum-Sha carries the locked commit).

docs.title: MCP tool surface (in the IDE)
docs.text:
Besides list_resources / get_resource, /mcp exposes prompt tools:

Tool What it does list_prompts Prompts visible to you (prompts are project-private), with declared variables get_prompt Without variables_json: template + variables; with it: server-side rendering (required/unknown variables validated)

IDE agents can use governed prompts directly; management actions (publish/version/approve) stay in the console and CLI.

docs.title: Python SDK(消费方)
docs.text: 应用程序在运行时消费注册中心资产的标准方式:agentrum.sdk。发现、取内容、渲染模板,一个入口;本地缓存让注册中心宕机不影响你的应用——这正是"控制面注册中心"的设计承诺。

docs.title: 安装与凭据
docs.text:
pip install agentrum          # 或无需安装:uvx agentrum …(CLI)

凭据解析顺序:显式参数 → AGENTRUM_AK/AGENTRUM_SK(或 AGENTRUM_TOKEN)环境变量 → agentrum login 存的本地凭据。推荐给应用配一把只读 scope 的项目 AK/SK(控制台 → 设置 → AK/SK)。

docs.title: resolve:四类资源一个入口
docs.text:
import agentrum.sdk as agentrum

registry = agentrum.Registry("https://registry.internal", ak=..., sk=...)

# MCP Server:拿到端点与连接头,直接用任意 MCP 客户端连接
server = registry.resolve("MCPServer/payment/payment-gateway")
#   server.endpoint, server.transport, server.headers(仅字面值;
#   secretRef 引用的头不会出库,需与属主团队另行约定)

# Agent:外部托管的有 spec.endpoint,控制器部署的看 Ready condition
# 里的 service_url(status.conditions[0].service_url)

# Skill:锁定 SHA + 内容
skill = registry.resolve("Skill/team/pay-skill")   # skill.sha
registry.fetch_skill("Skill/team/pay-skill", dest="./skills")

# Prompt:模板 + 声明式变量,本地渲染(缺失必填/传入未声明 → 报错)
prompt = registry.resolve("Prompt/team/review-style")
text = prompt.render(language="python")

docs.title: 缓存与宕机兜底
docs.text: resolve() 的结果按 TTL(默认 300s)落盘缓存(默认 ~/.agentrum/cache,可用 AGENTRUM_CACHE_DIR 或 cache_dir 覆盖)。注册中心不可达时返回过期的缓存副本(resolved.stale == True);4xx(凭据失效、资源不存在)不兜底,直接抛错——那是真实问题,不该被旧数据掩盖。

docs.title: Skill 内容交付
docs.text:
registry.fetch_skill("Skill/team/pay-skill", dest="./skills")

服务端用注册中心持有的凭据在锁定 SHA 上拉取并打包返回——私有仓库的订阅方拿得到内容,而凭据永不离开注册中心。解包使用 tarfile 的 data 过程滤器,成员路径逃逸会被拒绝。

等价的 REST 调用:GET /v1/resources/Skill/{ns}/{name}/content?tag=…(响应头 X-Agentrum-Sha 为锁定 commit)。

docs.title: MCP 工具面(IDE 内)
docs.text:
/mcp 除 list_resources / get_resource 外,还提供 Prompt 工具:

工具 说明 list_prompts 列出你能看到的 Prompt(Prompt 项目私有),含已声明变量 get_prompt 不带 variables_json 返回模板+变量;带则服务端渲染(必填/未声明强校验)

IDE Agent 可以直接"取用注册中心治理过的提示词",管理动作(发布/版本/审批)仍只在控制台与 CLI。

docs.title: SSO setup (admins)
docs.text: Agentrum's identity model: humans use JWT (SSO or account password), machines use project AK/SK. SSO is standard OIDC — any discovery-capable IdP works, and Feishu ships as a built-in preset. Local accounts remain for bootstrap.

docs.title: Generic OIDC (recommended)
docs.text:
For Keycloak / Casdoor / Authelia / Logto / Okta etc., register an OIDC application in your IdP (redirect URI: $ARK_OIDC_REDIRECT_BASE/v1/auth/oidc/generic/callback), then:

ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_ISSUER=https://sso.internal/realms/acme   # discovery is automatic
ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_CLIENT_ID=agentrum
ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_CLIENT_SECRET=...
ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_SCOPES="openid profile email"
ARK_OIDC_REDIRECT_BASE=https://registry.internal           # callback base
ARK_UI_ORIGIN=https://registry.internal                    # where browsers land after login

Verify with GET /v1/auth/oidc/providers; the login entry is GET /v1/auth/oidc/generic/login (307 to the IdP). id_tokens are verified against the IdP's JWKS (ES256/RS256) with iss/aud/exp/nonce checks.

docs.title: Feishu preset
docs.text:
Create an enterprise custom app on the Feishu Open Platform, enable web authorization, and set the callback to /v1/auth/oidc/feishu/callback:

ARK_FEISHU_APP_ID=cli_xxx
ARK_FEISHU_APP_SECRET=...

Feishu uses OAuth2 authorization-code + user_info (union_id/open_id as the subject).

docs.title: JIT provisioning & governance
docs.text:
• First SSO login auto-creates the user (username from preferred_username/name, de-duplicated with a suffix); identity is uniquely linked by (idp_provider, idp_subject)
  • SSO-created accounts have unusable passwords (random) — they can only sign in via SSO; disable/role changes go through the user-management API
  • Provisioning is audited (user.oidc_create); repeat logins never duplicate accounts
  • The local bootstrap admin is unaffected by SSO and serves as the break-glass path

docs.title: SSO 接入(管理员)
docs.text: Agentrum 的身份体系:人走 JWT(SSO 或账号密码),机器走项目 AK/SK。SSO 实现标准 OIDC——任何支持 discovery 的 IdP 都能接,飞书是内置预设;本地账号始终保留用于引导管理员。

docs.title: 通用 OIDC(推荐)
docs.text:
以 Keycloak / Casdoor / Authelia / Logto / Okta 等为例,在 IdP 建一个 OIDC 应用(回调地址填 $ARK_OIDC_REDIRECT_BASE/v1/auth/oidc/generic/callback),然后:

ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_ISSUER=https://sso.internal/realms/acme   # 会自动 discovery
ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_CLIENT_ID=agentrum
ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_CLIENT_SECRET=...
ARK_OIDC_GENERIC_SCOPES="openid profile email"
ARK_OIDC_REDIRECT_BASE=https://registry.internal           # 回调基址
ARK_UI_ORIGIN=https://registry.internal                    # 登录完成后跳回的 UI 地址

校验端点:GET /v1/auth/oidc/providers 返回已启用的 provider 列表;登录入口 GET /v1/auth/oidc/generic/login(307 到 IdP)。id_token 用 IdP 的 JWKS 验签(ES256/RS256),校验 iss/aud/exp/nonce。

docs.title: 飞书预设
docs.text:
飞书开放平台创建企业自建应用,开通网页应用授权,回调地址同上(路径为 /v1/auth/oidc/feishu/callback):

ARK_FEISHU_APP_ID=cli_xxx
ARK_FEISHU_APP_SECRET=...

飞书走 OAuth2 授权码 + user_info 模式(以 union_id/open_id 为身份主键)。

docs.title: JIT 建号与治理
docs.text:
• 首次 SSO 登录自动创建用户(用户名取 preferred_username/name,冲突自动加后缀),身份以 (idp_provider, idp_subject) 唯一关联
  • SSO 建出的账号密码不可用(随机),只能走 SSO;禁用/平台管理员授权在「用户管理」API 操作
  • 建号动作记录审计(user.oidc_create);后续登录不重复建号
  • 本地 bootstrap 管理员不受 SSO 影响,用于 IdP 故障时的兜底

docs.title: Subscription flow
docs.text:
Subscriber project member                  Owner project admin
     │ POST /v1/teams/{team}/subscriptions
     │ {kind, namespace, name | "*"}
     ├─ target internal ──► active at once ──► readable + notified on versions
     └─ target restricted ► pending_approval ─► owner admin decides
                                               ├─ approve → active (readable)
                                               └─ reject  → revoked
  • name: "*" subscribes to the whole namespace, but a wildcard subscription covers INTERNAL resources only; restricted resources always require an exact-name, owner-approved subscription
  • Subscribing to your own project → 409; subscribing to a Prompt → 400 (project-private); subscribing to a Secret → 400 (secrets are never shared across projects)
  • A rejected/revoked subscription can be requested again — the target is never locked forever
  • When a resource is deleted, every active subscriber receives a resource.deleted notification

docs.title: Delivery (transactional outbox)
docs.text: Notifications commit in the same transaction as the state change that caused them; a background dispatcher polls and delivers, retrying with exponential backoff (max 5 attempts, then failed). GET /v1/notifications (platform admin) exposes the pipeline.

docs.title: Channel 1: Feishu custom bot (recommended to start)
docs.text:
Feishu group → Settings → Bots → add a custom bot, grab the webhook URL:

ARK_FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL=https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/xxx
ARK_FEISHU_WEBHOOK_SECRET=...   # optional, enables signing

docs.title: Channel 2: Generic webhook (HMAC-signed)
docs.text:
ARK_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL=https://your-service/hook
ARK_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET=...

Delivery is a POST whose JSON body is the event payload; with a secret configured, a X-Agentrum-Signature: sha256_hex(payload) header is attached.

{
  "event": "resource.published",
  "kind": "MCPServer",
  "namespace": "payment",
  "name": "payment-gateway",
  "version": 3,
  "tag": "v1.3.0",
  "subscriber_team": "support",
  "published_by": "alice",
  "description": "Payment gateway MCP"
}

event values: resource.published / resource.deleted.

docs.title: Consumer graph (owner view)
docs.text:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" $SERVER/v1/teams/payment/consumers
# → [{"subscriber_team": "support", "kind": "MCPServer",
#     "namespace": "payment", "name": "payment-gateway", "since": "..."}]

Check this graph before deprecating or removing anything — it is your impact analysis.

docs.title: 订阅流程
docs.text:
订阅方项目成员                          属主项目管理员
     │ POST /v1/teams/{team}/subscriptions
     │ {kind, namespace, name | "*"}
     ├─ 目标 internal ──► 立即 active ──► 可读,且收到后续版本通知
     └─ 目标 restricted ─► pending_approval ─► 属主 admin 审批
                                               ├─ 批准 → active(可读)
                                               └─ 拒绝 → revoked
  • name 传 * 表示订阅整个命名空间,但通配订阅只覆盖 internal 资源;restricted 资源永远需要精确名称且经属主审批的订阅
  • 订阅自身项目会得到 409;订阅 Prompt 得到 400(项目私有);订阅 Secret 得到 400(密钥不跨项目分发)
  • 被拒绝(revoked)的订阅可以重新发起,不会永久占用目标
  • 资源被删除时,所有 active 订阅方会收到 resource.deleted 通知

docs.title: 通知投递(事务性 outbox)
docs.text: 通知与引发它的状态变更同事务落库,后台投递器按间隔轮询投递,失败按指数退避重试(最多 5 次后标记 failed),GET /v1/notifications 可观测(平台管理员)。

docs.title: 渠道 1:飞书群机器人(推荐起步)
docs.text:
飞书群 → 设置 → 群机器人 → 添加自定义机器人,拿到 webhook URL:

ARK_FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL=https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/xxx
ARK_FEISHU_WEBHOOK_SECRET=...   # 可选,开启签名校验

docs.title: 渠道 2:通用 Webhook(HMAC 签名)
docs.text:
ARK_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL=https://your-service/hook
ARK_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET=...

投递为 POST,JSON body 即事件负载;配置了 secret 时附带 X-Agentrum-Signature: sha256_hex(payload) 请求头供校验。

{
  "event": "resource.published",
  "kind": "MCPServer",
  "namespace": "payment",
  "name": "payment-gateway",
  "version": 3,
  "tag": "v1.3.0",
  "subscriber_team": "support",
  "published_by": "alice",
  "description": "支付网关 MCP"
}

event 取值:resource.published / resource.deleted。

docs.title: 消费方图谱(属主视角)
docs.text:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" $SERVER/v1/teams/payment/consumers
# → [{"subscriber_team": "support", "kind": "MCPServer",
#     "namespace": "payment", "name": "payment-gateway", "since": "..."}]

下线或废弃资源前,先查这张图谱评估影响面。
